title: Reefer Cargo Services: when a change to the carrying settings can be accepted
content:
## Scope

This clause of **Reefer Cargo Services** decides whether a change to the carrying settings of a reefer service (set point, ventilation, humidity set point, oxygen or carbon dioxide set point) can be accepted: who may instruct it, the range it must respect, how many changes a service takes, and whether a change is possible after the vessel has departed.

## Rule

1. Carrying settings change **only on the shipper's written instruction**.
2. The new settings must stay inside the tier's accepted ranges, the same set-point, ventilation, humidity and atmosphere ranges that govern an order for that tier.
3. A service takes **at most** the tier's maximum number of setting changes. The count is the number of setting-change records already on the service over its life before the change being handled, including records made at 0.00 USD.
4. After departure a change is possible only **remotely**, and only on tiers that allow in-transit setting changes.

## Tier table

| Tier | Maximum setting changes per service | Remote setting change after departure |
|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | 3 | Not allowed |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | 5 | Allowed |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | 1 | Not allowed |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | 2 | Not allowed |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | 5 | Allowed |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | 2 | Not allowed |

## Decision table

| Question | Answer that allows the change |
|---|---|
| Is there a written instruction from the shipper? | Yes |
| Do all new settings lie inside the tier's ranges? | Yes |
| Is the number of setting-change records already on the service below the tier's maximum? | Yes |
| If the vessel has departed: does the tier allow remote changes after departure? | Yes |

A change that fails any of these questions is not accepted under this clause.

## Hypothetical cases

> **AHL Reefer Cold Treatment**, one setting-change record already on the service. The maximum is 1, so a further change is not accepted.

> **AHL Reefer Standard**, two setting-change records already, one of them at 0.00 USD. Both count; a third change stays within the maximum of 3, and a fourth would not.

> **AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere**, vessel already at sea, the shipper emails a new set point. The tier does not allow setting changes after departure, so the change is not accepted.

> **AHL Reefer Pharma GDP**, vessel at sea, written instruction to change the set point within range, two change records so far. The tier allows remote changes after departure and the count is below 5, so this clause does not stand in the way.

## Basis Q&A

**The consignee phones to ask for a colder set point. Can it be applied?** Settings change only on the shipper's written instruction; a telephone request from the consignee is not that.

**Does a change recorded free of charge use up one of the permitted changes?** Yes. Records made at 0.00 USD are counted.
